title: 悯农·其二
appreciation: 这首诗描绘了烈日当空下农民辛勤耕作的真实图景，以通俗质朴而极具张力的语言，揭示了每一粒粮食都饱含血汗的深刻道理。全诗语言真切，发人深省，千百年来成为戒奢尚俭、体恤民力的传世警句。

lines.translation: 农夫顶着烈日正午在田地里给禾苗锄草松土。
lines.explanation: 【锄禾】用锄头松土除草以利禾苗生长。【日当午】正当正午，烈日当空，气温最高之时。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 锄禾日当午, mood of 悯农·其二, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 一颗颗晶莹滚烫的汗珠，滴落在禾苗下的泥土深处。
lines.explanation: 【汗滴】汗珠滴落，写出劳作的极度艰辛与体能消耗。【禾下土】禾苗根部的土壤。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 汗滴禾下土, mood of 悯农·其二, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 有谁能真正想到，我们饭桌盘中的每一餐饭食，
lines.explanation: 【盘中餐】盛在盘子里的食物饭菜，代指人们日常享用的每一餐。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 谁知盘中餐, mood of 悯农·其二, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 每一粒米饭都凝聚着耕作者无尽的辛劳与汗水！
lines.explanation: 【粒粒】每一颗粮食。【皆】全都是。【辛苦】辛勤与劳苦。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 粒粒皆辛苦, mood of 悯农·其二, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 悯农·其一
appreciation: 春种秋收本是丰收景象，然而在严酷的赋税与剥削下，四海无闲田，农夫犹饿死，深刻揭露了当时社会极不平等的残酷现实。

lines.translation: 春天在田里播下一颗小小的谷物种子。
lines.explanation: 【粟】谷子，指代农作物的种子。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 春种一粒粟, mood of 悯农·其一, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 到了秋天便能收获上万颗金黄饱满的粮食。
lines.explanation: 【万颗子】形容果实极其丰盛。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 秋收万颗子, mood of 悯农·其一, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 普天之下举目皆是绿油油的耕地，没有一块荒芜的田野。
lines.explanation: 【四海】普天下、全国各地。【闲田】荒芜不种的田地。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 四海无闲田, mood of 悯农·其一, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 然而辛勤劳作终年的老农，却依然免不了被活活饿死！
lines.explanation: 【犹】仍然，还是。形成极为震撼的悲剧对比。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 农夫犹饿死, mood of 悯农·其一, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 池上
appreciation: 诗人以白描的手法，生动活泼地描绘了一个天真烂漫的小孩偷采白莲的情景。小娃不懂得掩饰行迹，留下一道浮萍水痕，童趣盎然，栩栩如生。

lines.translation: 天真活泼的小孩独自划着一叶小小的木舟。
lines.explanation: 【小娃】男孩、幼童。【小艇】轻便的小船。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 小娃撑小艇, mood of 池上, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 悄悄摘采了池塘里的新鲜白莲，满载欢喜划船归来。
lines.explanation: 【偷采】瞒着大人采摘，表现孩童的淘气烂漫。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 偷采白莲回, mood of 池上, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 小孩子还不懂得如何去隐匿自己的行踪，
lines.explanation: 【不解】不懂得、不知道。【踪迹】行动留下的痕迹。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 不解藏踪迹, mood of 池上, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 水面密密匝匝的绿色浮萍，顺着小艇荡开了一条清晰的水路！
lines.explanation: 【浮萍】水生植物，浮在水面。【开】被船头划破分向两边。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 浮萍一道开, mood of 池上, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 咏鹅
appreciation: 相传是骆宾王七岁时的神童之作。开篇三字呼告，生动传神，红掌清波，白羽绿水，色彩明丽，极具动感与画面美。

lines.translation: 大白鹅啊大白鹅！欢快地引吭高歌。
lines.explanation: 【鹅】摹拟白鹅欢畅的鸣叫声与呼唤。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 鹅鹅鹅, mood of 咏鹅, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 弯曲着长长的白颈，对着蔚蓝的天空欢快鸣唱。
lines.explanation: 【曲项】弯曲的颈项。【向天歌】昂首鸣叫。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 曲项向天歌, mood of 咏鹅, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 雪白的羽毛静静漂浮在碧绿清澈的水面上。
lines.explanation: 【白毛】雪白羽毛。【绿水】清碧池水，色彩鲜明对照。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 白毛浮绿水, mood of 咏鹅, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 红色的脚掌轻轻划动着碧波荡漾的涟漪。
lines.explanation: 【红掌】鹅鲜红的蹼掌。【拨】划动。【清波】清澈的水波。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 红掌拨清波, mood of 咏鹅, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 过故人庄
appreciation: 孟浩然隐逸田园的代表作。全诗如话家常，语言平淡却蕴含浓郁真挚的友谊与淳朴的乡村风情，青山郭外，绿树村边，令人心驰神往。

lines.translation: 老朋友备好了丰盛的农家饭菜与醇香黄米饭，
lines.explanation: 【故人】老朋友。【具】准备。【鸡黍】杀鸡做黄米饭，农家待客至诚之礼。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 故人具鸡黍, mood of 过故人庄, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 热情邀请我到他质朴宁静的农家作客。
lines.explanation: 【田家】田野间的农家住所。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 邀我至田家, mood of 过故人庄, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 翠绿茂密的树木环绕在村庄四周，
lines.explanation: 【合】环绕，簇拥成荫。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 绿树村边合, mood of 过故人庄, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 青翠连绵的山峰在村外城郭旁横卧斜倚。
lines.explanation: 【郭】古代城墙外围的城郭，此指村庄外围。【斜】倾斜、横亘延绵。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 青山郭外斜, mood of 过故人庄, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 推开雕花窗户，正对着打谷场与菜园圃地，
lines.explanation: 【开轩】推开窗户。【场圃】打谷平场与蔬菜园子。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 开轩面场圃, mood of 过故人庄, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 手端着农家美酒，促膝笑谈农桑麻麦的长势。
lines.explanation: 【把酒】端起酒杯。【话桑麻】谈论农桑作物的耕作收成。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 把酒话桑麻, mood of 过故人庄, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 等到九月九日重阳佳节到来的那一天，
lines.explanation: 【重阳日】农历九月初九重阳节，登高赏菊之时。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 待到重阳日, mood of 过故人庄, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 我一定还要再来你这里，一边饮酒一边共赏灿烂秋菊！
lines.explanation: 【还】再、又。【就菊花】走近菊花，指饮菊花酒赏秋菊。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 还来就菊花, mood of 过故人庄, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 登鹳雀楼
appreciation: 前两句写景，落日依山、黄河奔海，气魄雄浑吞吐天地；后两句入理，欲穷千里、更上一层，展现出勇攀高峰、开阔胸襟的崇高人生境界。

lines.translation: 灿烂耀眼的落日贴着连绵起伏的群山缓缓沉落，
lines.explanation: 【白日】傍晚仍耀眼的日光。【依】依傍、靠着。【尽】沉没隐没。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 白日依山尽, mood of 登鹳雀楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 浩瀚奔腾的黄河水奔流东去，滚滚汇入茫茫大海。
lines.explanation: 【黄河】中华母亲河。【入海流】浩浩荡荡奔流入海。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 黄河入海流, mood of 登鹳雀楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 若是想要极目远眺，看尽千里辽阔的壮丽江山，
lines.explanation: 【欲】想要。【穷】穷尽、看透。【千里目】极目远望的视线。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 欲穷千里目, mood of 登鹳雀楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 那就必须打起精神，再登上更高一层楼台！
lines.explanation: 【更】再。【更上一层楼】更上一层，喻指不断进取超越。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 更上一层楼, mood of 登鹳雀楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 望庐山瀑布
appreciation: 李白浪漫主义诗歌的巅峰之作。生紫烟、挂前川、三千尺、落九天，奇思妙想，飞扬跋扈，将庐山瀑布的磅礴气势写得如梦似幻、气吞山河。

lines.pinyin: rì zhào xiāng lú shēng zǐ yān
lines.translation: 金色的阳光普照在香炉峰上，水气弥漫蒸腾起如梦似幻的紫色云烟，
lines.explanation: 【香炉】香炉峰，庐山名峰。【生紫烟】阳光折射云气呈现出紫气。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 日照香炉生紫烟, mood of 望庐山瀑布, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: yáo kàn pù bù guà qián chuān
lines.translation: 远远望去，壮丽的瀑布犹如一条晶莹的白练高悬在山川江水前方。
lines.explanation: 【遥看】远远观望。【挂前川】如白绢高高悬挂于山川江流之间。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 遥看瀑布挂前川, mood of 望庐山瀑布, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: fēi liú zhí xià sān qiān chǐ
lines.translation: 湍急凶猛的水流从高崖陡壁笔直奔泻而下数千尺，
lines.explanation: 【飞流直下】形容水势迅疾奔涌直落。【三千尺】极言崖壁之高深险峻。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 飞流直下三千尺, mood of 望庐山瀑布, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: yí shì yín hé luò jiǔ tiān
lines.translation: 恍惚间真让人怀疑是那璀璨的九天银河从最高苍穹跌落人间！
lines.explanation: 【疑是】令人怀疑、仿佛是。【银河】天河。【九天】古代称天有九重，指极高之天空。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 疑是银河落九天, mood of 望庐山瀑布, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 早发白帝城
appreciation: 公元759年李白流放夜郎途中遇赦，心情狂喜，放舟东下江陵。全诗节奏欢快轻捷，舟行若飞，猿啼岸走，把遇赦后绝处逢生的快意抒发得淋漓尽致。

lines.pinyin: cháo cí bái dì cǎi yún jiān
lines.translation: 清晨我辞别高耸入云、彩霞缭绕的白帝城，
lines.explanation: 【朝】清晨。【辞】告别。【彩云间】形容白帝城地势极高，高插云霄。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 朝辞白帝彩云间, mood of 早发白帝城, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: qiān lǐ jiāng líng yī rì hái
lines.translation: 顺江而下远在千里之外的江陵，轻舟一日便能飞渡抵还！
lines.explanation: 【千里】极言路途遥远。【一日还】一天就能返回，极写船行之神速与心境之轻快。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 千里江陵一日还, mood of 早发白帝城, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: liǎng àn yuán shēng tí bú zhù
lines.translation: 两岸高峡深谷之间，猿猴凄厉清脆的啼叫声还在耳边回荡不休，
lines.explanation: 【啼不住】啼叫声绵延不断。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 两岸猿声啼不住, mood of 早发白帝城, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: qīng zhōu yǐ guò wàn zhòng shān
lines.translation: 那轻捷迅疾的小船，早已穿过层层叠叠的万座崇山峻岭！
lines.explanation: 【轻舟】轻便轻快的小船。【万重山】层峦叠嶂的重重山峰。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 轻舟已过万重山, mood of 早发白帝城, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 春晓
appreciation: 没有华丽辞藻，孟浩然抓住春晨刚刚醒来那一瞬间的听觉与心理感受，写出春光的明媚、风雨的洗礼与对落花的怜惜，自然天成，情趣盎然。

lines.translation: 春日夜色沉沉睡得十分香甜，不知不觉天已破晓拂晓，
lines.explanation: 【不觉晓】不知不觉天已经亮了。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 春眠不觉晓, mood of 春晓, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 醒来时只听见庭院树丛到处都是鸟儿清脆欢快的啼鸣。
lines.explanation: 【闻】听见。【啼鸟】鸟鸣声。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 处处闻啼鸟, mood of 春晓, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 回想昨夜枕边依稀听见的那阵阵风吹雨落的声响，
lines.explanation: 【夜来】昨夜、夜里。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 夜来风雨声, mood of 春晓, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 不知那枝头盛开的娇艳花朵，又被打落了多少朵呢？
lines.explanation: 【知多少】不知有多少，表达诗人对烂漫春光的深情与怜惜。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 花落知多少, mood of 春晓, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 独坐敬亭山
appreciation: 李白晚年漂泊宣城时所作。群鸟飞尽，孤云独去，人与自然在此刻达成了至深的情感共鸣，相看两不厌，唯有敬亭山，物我两忘，意境超拔。

lines.translation: 成群飞鸣的鸟儿都已高高飞向远方，消失不见，
lines.explanation: 【尽】消失殆尽。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 众鸟高飞尽, mood of 独坐敬亭山, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 天边一片孤单的白云，也独自悠闲自在地飘向远方。
lines.explanation: 【独去】独自飘散。【闲】悠闲、从容。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 孤云独去闲, mood of 独坐敬亭山, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 在这寂静的天地间，我看着青山，青山凝望着我，彼此久看也不觉得厌倦，
lines.explanation: 【两不厌】彼此互相看着都不会感到厌烦。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 相看两不厌, mood of 独坐敬亭山, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 能够这般相知相伴相守的，如今也只有眼前巍峨的敬亭山了！
lines.explanation: 【敬亭山】在今安徽宣城，诗人借山寄托孤高傲岸之情。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 只有敬亭山, mood of 独坐敬亭山, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 望岳
appreciation: 青年杜甫漫游齐赵，眺望东岳泰山所作。全诗没有一个“爬”字，却将泰山的磅礴气势与神奇造化写尽，结句“会当凌绝顶，一览众山小”成为千古昂扬进取的座右铭。

lines.translation: 那五岳之首的东岳泰山究竟是怎样一副雄奇非凡的模样呢？
lines.explanation: 【岱宗】泰山的尊称，居五岳之首。【夫如何】到底怎么样呢。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 岱宗夫如何, mood of 望岳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 横跨齐鲁大地，那苍翠青碧的山色连绵无际，永无止境！
lines.explanation: 【齐鲁】古代齐国与鲁国之地。【未了】没有尽头，极言山色之辽阔苍茫。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 齐鲁青未了, mood of 望岳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 大自然造化把天地间最神异秀丽的景色都凝聚在此，
lines.explanation: 【造化】天地大自然。【钟】集聚、赋予。【神秀】神妙秀美。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 造化钟神秀, mood of 望岳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 高耸入云的山峰巍然耸立，将山南的明媚与山北的昏暗清晰割裂！
lines.explanation: 【阴阳】山北为阴，山南为阳。【割】分割。【昏晓】黄昏与早晨。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 阴阳割昏晓, mood of 望岳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 山间层层叠叠涌动的白云，荡涤着我的胸怀让人顿觉胸襟大开，
lines.explanation: 【曾云】曾同“层”，层层重叠的云雾。【荡胸】洗涤心胸。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 荡胸生曾云, mood of 望岳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 我睁大眼睛极目远眺，看那些倦飞归林的鸟儿渐渐没入暮霭云壑深处。
lines.explanation: 【决眦】眼眶睁得极大，极言凝神远眺。【归鸟】归巢的飞鸟。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 决眦入归鸟, mood of 望岳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 有朝一日我一定要攀登上泰山的最高峰顶，
lines.explanation: 【会当】一定要、终当。【凌】登上、高居。【绝顶】最高顶峰。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 会当凌绝顶, mood of 望岳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 俯瞰脚下的群山，它们都会显得如此渺小！
lines.explanation: 【一览】一眼望去。【众山小】群山均显得矮小，化用《孟子》孔子登泰山而小天下。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 一览众山小, mood of 望岳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 绝句·两个黄鹂鸣翠柳
title_pinyin: jué jù liǎng gè huáng lí míng cuì liǔ
appreciation: 杜甫寓居成都浣花溪草堂时所作。全诗四句四景，两黄鹂、白鹭、千秋雪、万里船，声色交织，动静相宜，空间由近及远由古及今，工整优美，堪称七绝绝唱。

lines.pinyin: liǎng gè huáng lí míng cuì liǔ
lines.translation: 两只娇小可爱的黄鹂鸟在翠绿如烟的柳枝间欢快鸣叫，
lines.explanation: 【黄鹂】黄莺鸟。【鸣】婉转啼鸣。【翠柳】青绿柳树。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 两个黄鹂鸣翠柳, mood of 绝句·两个黄鹂鸣翠柳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: yī xíng bái lù shàng qīng tiān
lines.translation: 一行雪白优雅的白鹭振翅高飞，飞向湛蓝纯净的青天苍穹。
lines.explanation: 【白鹭】水鸟，羽毛纯白。【青天】湛蓝蔚蓝的天空。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 一行白鹭上青天, mood of 绝句·两个黄鹂鸣翠柳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: chuāng hán xī lǐng qiān qiū xuě
lines.translation: 雕花木窗宛如精致画框，嵌映着西岭积聚千年的皑皑白雪，
lines.explanation: 【西岭】成都西部的岷山。【千秋雪】千百年不化的积雪。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 窗含西岭千秋雪, mood of 绝句·两个黄鹂鸣翠柳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: mén pō dōng wú wàn lǐ chuán
lines.translation: 门前码头边静静停泊着即将顺流东下、开往万里之外东吴的客船。
lines.explanation: 【门泊】门前停靠。【东吴】古代长江下游江苏一带。【万里船】航行万里的大船。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 门泊东吴万里船, mood of 绝句·两个黄鹂鸣翠柳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 绝句·迟日江山丽
title_pinyin: jué jù chí rì jiāng shān lì
appreciation: 杜甫写春天的又一名篇。春日融融，江山秀美，春风轻拂，花草飘香。燕子衔泥筑巢，鸳鸯沙滩安歇，一动一静，和谐生动，洋溢着春回大地的欣悦。

lines.translation: 温暖明媚的春日普照之下，大好江山展现出格外秀丽的姿容，
lines.explanation: 【迟日】春季白天渐长，阳光温和。【丽】秀美明媚。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 迟日江山丽, mood of 绝句·迟日江山丽, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 柔和的春风徐徐吹来，送来阵阵百花盛开、绿草萌发的幽香。
lines.explanation: 【花草香】花草散发的芬芳清香。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 春风花草香, mood of 绝句·迟日江山丽, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 溪边的泥土渐渐化冻松软湿润，灵巧的燕子正忙着衔泥筑巢，
lines.explanation: 【泥融】春暖泥土湿润松软。【飞燕子】燕子欢飞。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 泥融飞燕子, mood of 绝句·迟日江山丽, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 温暖干燥的沙滩上，成双成对的鸳鸯正静静依偎着安睡。
lines.explanation: 【沙暖】春阳照耀下沙滩温热。【鸳鸯】水鸟，常成双栖息。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 沙暖睡鸳鸯, mood of 绝句·迟日江山丽, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 春夜喜雨
appreciation: 杜甫久旱逢甘霖的欣喜之作。好雨知时节，潜入夜，润物细无声。全诗没有一个“喜”字，却处处流露出喜悦关切之情，拟人手法出神入化。

lines.translation: 这一场及时的好雨仿佛通晓季节的需要，
lines.explanation: 【好雨】及时雨。【时节】节气、农时。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 好雨知时节, mood of 春夜喜雨, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 正值生机勃发的万物春季，便悄然降临人间润泽大地。
lines.explanation: 【发生】萌发生长、降临催生。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 当春乃发生, mood of 春夜喜雨, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 伴随着柔和的夜风在不知不觉间潜入漫漫长夜，
lines.explanation: 【潜】暗暗地、悄悄无声。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 随风潜入夜, mood of 春夜喜雨, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 无声无息、细密绵长地滋润着世间生机勃勃的万事万物。
lines.explanation: 【润物】滋养万物生长。【细无声】细密轻柔毫无喧嚣。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 润物细无声, mood of 春夜喜雨, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 田野间蜿蜒的小径与天际浓厚的乌云融为一体，一片漆黑，
lines.explanation: 【野径】田野小路。【俱】都。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 野径云俱黑, mood of 春夜喜雨, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 唯有浩渺江面上停泊的渔船上，闪烁着一点孤单微弱的灯火。
lines.explanation: 【火独明】唯有一点渔火独自明亮。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 江船火独明, mood of 春夜喜雨, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 等到清晨拂晓时分再去观瞧那红艳艳、湿漉漉的地方，
lines.explanation: 【晓】清晨破晓。【红湿处】带雨湿润的红花丛。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 晓看红湿处, mood of 春夜喜雨, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 那重重锦绣花朵饱含雨水，必将开遍整个锦官城！
lines.explanation: 【花重】花朵沾满雨水沉甸甸。【锦官城】成都的别称。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 花重锦官城, mood of 春夜喜雨, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 江雪
appreciation: 柳宗元被贬永州时的托物言志绝唱。千山无鸟，万径无人，冰雪极寒之中，唯有一位蓑笠老翁独钓寒江。表现出诗人在逆境中不妥协、傲岸不屈的高洁灵魂。

lines.translation: 群山连绵千里，所有的飞鸟都已经绝迹不见，
lines.explanation: 【绝】断绝、消失。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 千山鸟飞绝, mood of 江雪, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 千条万条大路小径上，所有行人的足迹都已被风雪掩埋。
lines.explanation: 【人踪】行人的脚印踪迹。【灭】消失无影。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 万径人踪灭, mood of 江雪, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 孤零零的一叶轻舟上，一位身披草蓑、头戴斗笠的渔翁，
lines.explanation: 【孤舟】孤单的小船。【蓑笠翁】穿蓑衣戴斗笠的老渔翁。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 孤舟蓑笠翁, mood of 江雪, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.translation: 独自冒着漫天冰雪，在冰冷刺骨的江面上垂钓！
lines.explanation: 【独钓】独自垂钓。【寒江雪】冰封雪锁的寒江。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 独钓寒江雪, mood of 江雪, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 山行
appreciation: 杜牧秋日漫游的经典。石径斜、白云深处、枫林晚、红于二月花，将秋天的生机与艳丽写得比春天还要明媚灿烂，展现出昂扬豁达的审美情趣。

lines.pinyin: yuǎn shàng hán shān shí jìng xié
lines.translation: 沿着崎岖蜿蜒的石头小径，远远攀登向深秋清凉的山顶，
lines.explanation: 【寒山】深秋时节的山峦。【石径斜】石头小路蜿蜒倾斜盘旋。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 远上寒山石径斜, mood of 山行, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: bái yún shēng chù yǒu rén jiā
lines.translation: 在白云缭绕升腾的深山隐秘之处，隐约可见几户山民人家。
lines.explanation: 【白云生处】浮云涌动升起的高处。【人家】山民居所。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 白云生处有人家, mood of 山行, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: tíng chē zuò ài fēng lín wǎn
lines.translation: 停下行进的马车，只因为深深迷恋这夕阳晚照下如火如荼的枫林，
lines.explanation: 【坐】因为。【爱】喜爱。【枫林晚】傍晚夕阳映照下的枫树林。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 停车坐爱枫林晚, mood of 山行, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: shuāng yè hóng yú èr yuè huā
lines.translation: 那经受了秋霜浸染的枫叶，比早春二月盛开的鲜花还要艳丽通红！
lines.explanation: 【霜叶】霜打过的枫叶。【红于】比……更红。【二月花】仲春二月的春花。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 霜叶红于二月花, mood of 山行, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 咏柳
appreciation: 通过巧妙的拟人与设问，将初春柳树的新绿与柔韧写得神采飞扬。末两句以“不知细叶谁裁出，二月春风似剪刀”出人意表，把无形的春风具象化，灵动神妙。

lines.pinyin: bì yù zhuāng chéng yī shù gāo
lines.translation: 高高的柳树宛如亭亭玉立的少女，被碧绿无瑕的美玉装扮一新，
lines.explanation: 【碧玉】青绿色的美玉，比喻新绿柳叶。【妆成】装扮打扮而成。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 碧玉妆成一树高, mood of 咏柳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: wàn tiáo chuí xià lǜ sī tāo
lines.translation: 千万条柔嫩纤细的柳枝袅袅下垂，宛如垂悬的绿色丝织飘带。
lines.explanation: 【万条】无数柳枝。【绿丝绦】绿色的丝织带子。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 万条垂下绿丝绦, mood of 咏柳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: bù zhī xì yè shuí cái chū
lines.translation: 真不知道这细巧精致的柳叶究竟出自哪位巧手之人的裁剪？
lines.explanation: 【裁出】裁剪出来。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 不知细叶谁裁出, mood of 咏柳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

lines.pinyin: èr yuè chūn fēng shì jiǎn dāo
lines.translation: 原来正是那二月里轻拂大地的暖暖春风，宛如一把神奇灵巧的剪刀！
lines.explanation: 【二月春风】仲春早春的和风。【似剪刀】比作神奇的裁锦剪刀。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 二月春风似剪刀, mood of 咏柳, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor. Consistent character reference applied across this poem.

title: 江南春
appreciation: 千里江南春景尽收笔底。莺啼绿红、水村山郭、酒旗掩映，又引出南朝四百八十寺在烟雨楼台中的历史兴衰感，意境开阔，画卷壮美。

lines.pinyin: qiān lǐ yīng tí lǜ yìng hóng
lines.translation: 千里辽阔的江南水乡到处是黄莺啼鸣，红花绿叶交相辉映，
lines.explanation: 【莺啼】黄莺欢鸣。【绿映红】红绿交映，形容江南春意极浓。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 千里莺啼绿映红, mood of 江南春, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: shuǐ cūn shān guō jiǔ qí fēng
lines.translation: 临水的村庄、依山的城郭旁，酒家的旗幡在春风中高高飘展。
lines.explanation: 【水村】滨水渔村。【山郭】依山城郭。【酒旗】酒家招牌旗帜。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 水村山郭酒旗风, mood of 江南春, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: nán cháo sì bǎi bā shí sì
lines.translation: 南朝当年修建的数以千计的庄严佛寺寺院，
lines.explanation: 【南朝】宋齐梁陈四朝。【四百八十寺】虚指寺庙极其繁多。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 南朝四百八十寺, mood of 江南春, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: duō shǎo lóu tái yān yǔ zhōng
lines.translation: 如今有多少重重殿宇楼台，正笼罩在茫茫无际的蒙蒙烟雨之中！
lines.explanation: 【楼台】殿堂楼阁。【烟雨】蒙蒙春雨与水雾。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 多少楼台烟雨中, mood of 江南春, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 清明
appreciation: 传世清明第一绝唱。雨纷纷、欲断魂、借问酒家、牧童遥指杏花村。短短四句情景交融，起承转合自然天成，成为千百年来清明节最深沉温暖的文化符号。

lines.pinyin: qīng míng shí jié yǔ fēn fēn
lines.translation: 清明节气到来的时候，绵绵密密的春雨淅淅沥沥下个不停，
lines.explanation: 【清明时节】农历清明前后扫墓踏青之时。【雨纷纷】细雨连绵不绝。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 清明时节雨纷纷, mood of 清明, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: lù shàng xíng rén yù duàn hún
lines.translation: 泥泞古道上冒雨奔波的旅人，神情凄迷恍惚、思亲之痛伤感欲绝。
lines.explanation: 【断魂】形容极度悲伤凄凉，精神迷惘。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 路上行人欲断魂, mood of 清明, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: jiè wèn jiǔ jiā hé chù yǒu
lines.translation: 急切地询问路旁的放牛牧童：请问这附近哪儿有歇脚饮酒的小店？
lines.explanation: 【借问】向人打听询问。【酒家】卖酒的客栈店铺。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 借问酒家何处有, mood of 清明, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: mù tóng yáo zhǐ xìng huā cūn
lines.translation: 牧童骑在牛背上抬起手来，远远指向那繁花似锦的杏花村庄。
lines.explanation: 【牧童】放牧的小童。【遥指】远远指向。【杏花村】盛开杏花的村落。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 牧童遥指杏花村, mood of 清明, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 望洞庭
appreciation: 刘禹锡赴任途经洞庭湖所作。月光如水，湖面平如未磨之镜；青翠君山宛如白银盘中的青螺。比喻新奇巧妙，笔调清新空灵，勾勒出洞庭秋夜的宁静祥和。

lines.pinyin: hú guāng qiū yuè liǎng xiāng hé
lines.translation: 秋夜里清澈的洞庭湖水波光与皎洁月色融洽相合，
lines.explanation: 【两相和】水光与月色和谐交融，融为一体。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 湖光秋月两相和, mood of 望洞庭, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: tán miàn wú fēng jìng wèi mó
lines.translation: 平静的湖面上没有一丝微风，如同一面尚未打磨的巨大铜镜。
lines.explanation: 【潭面】湖水表面。【镜未磨】古铜镜未经磨砺表面微朦，比喻湖面平柔无波。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 潭面无风镜未磨, mood of 望洞庭, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: yáo wàng dòng tíng shān shuǐ cuì
lines.translation: 远远眺望洞庭湖青山绿水的开阔胜景，
lines.explanation: 【山水翠】指湖水与君山青翠碧绿。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 遥望洞庭山水翠, mood of 望洞庭, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: bái yín pán lǐ yī qīng luó
lines.translation: 那君山宛如在一只巨大的白银托盘中，安放着一枚小巧玲珑的青翠青螺。
lines.explanation: 【白银盘】比喻皎洁波光的洞庭湖。【青螺】青色螺蛳，比喻湖中君山。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 白银盘里一青螺, mood of 望洞庭, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 滁州西涧
appreciation: 韦应物任滁州刺史时的写景绝唱。独怜幽草、深树黄鹂、春潮带雨、野渡无人舟自横。后两句意境极幽深悠远，表现出一种遗世独立的恬淡之美。

lines.pinyin: dú lián yōu cǎo jiàn biān shēng
lines.translation: 我唯独喜爱那在溪涧水边静静萌生的小草，幽静而充满生机，
lines.explanation: 【独怜】唯独喜爱。【幽草】幽僻清净处生长的小草。【涧】山谷小溪。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 独怜幽草涧边生, mood of 滁州西涧, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: shàng yǒu huáng lí shēn shù míng
lines.translation: 幽草上方那浓密葱郁的深林树冠中，传来黄鹂鸟婉转清脆的啼叫。
lines.explanation: 【深树】枝叶茂密的树林。【鸣】啼叫鸣唱。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 上有黄鹂深树鸣, mood of 滁州西涧, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: chūn cháo dài yǔ wǎn lái jí
lines.translation: 傍晚时分春潮伴随着暴雨汹涌而至，溪水漫溢湍急奔腾，
lines.explanation: 【春潮】春汛上涨的潮水。【晚来急】傍晚水势越来越凶急。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 春潮带雨晚来急, mood of 滁州西涧, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: yě dù wú rén zhōu zì héng
lines.translation: 荒野渡口上空无一人，只有一叶孤舟在水波拍击中自在地横斜漂泊。
lines.explanation: 【野渡】荒郊外的野渡口。【舟自横】无人撑船，木船自由横斜漂浮。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 野渡无人舟自横, mood of 滁州西涧, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 暮江吟
appreciation: 白居易赴任杭州途中所作。一道残阳铺水中，半江瑟瑟半江红；可怜九月初三夜，露似真珠月似弓。观察入微，色彩浓淡相谐，语言浅近如话，令人沉醉。

lines.pinyin: yī dào cán yáng pù shuǐ zhōng
lines.translation: 一抹绚丽的落日晚霞斜斜铺展倾洒在江水中央，
lines.explanation: 【残阳】快要落山的夕阳。【铺】斜照在水面，体现夕阳低斜广阔。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 一道残阳铺水中, mood of 暮江吟, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: bàn jiāng sè sè bàn jiāng hóng
lines.translation: 半边江水呈现出幽静碧绿的颜色，另外半边江水被夕阳染得一片通红！
lines.explanation: 【瑟瑟】碧绿、深青色宝石名，这里指江水深绿。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 半江瑟瑟半江红, mood of 暮江吟, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: kě lián jiǔ yuè chū sān yè
lines.translation: 最是令人怜爱迷醉的，当属这农历九月初三的宁静秋夜，
lines.explanation: 【可怜】可爱、令人怜爱。【九月初三】农历初三，弯月初升之时。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 可怜九月初三夜, mood of 暮江吟, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: lù shì zhēn zhū yuè shì gōng
lines.translation: 滴滴夜露宛如圆润璀璨的珍珠，天边初升的新月宛若一张精致弯弓！
lines.explanation: 【真珠】即珍珠。【月似弓】初三弯月如弓。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 露似真珠月似弓, mood of 暮江吟, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 宿建德江
appreciation: 移舟泊烟渚，日暮客愁新。野旷天低树，江清月近人。字字洗炼，客子孤舟夜泊，在空旷无边的天地间，唯有江中明月与人相伴，诗意空灵幽渺。

lines.translation: 将船划动靠岸，停泊在薄雾轻烟笼罩的小洲水渚旁，
lines.explanation: 【移舟】摇动小船靠近岸边。【烟渚】烟雾笼罩的水中小洲。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 移舟泊烟渚, mood of 宿建德江, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 暮色苍茫黄昏降临，羁旅异乡的心头又涌上阵阵崭新的离愁。
lines.explanation: 【日暮】黄昏日落。【客愁】旅居在外游子的愁思。【新】新添生发。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 日暮客愁新, mood of 宿建德江, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 极目远望原野一片空旷辽阔，远方的苍穹显得比树梢还要低垂，
lines.explanation: 【野旷】原野旷远空阔。【天低树】天幕下垂，仿佛比树冠还低。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 野旷天低树, mood of 宿建德江, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 江水澄澈清亮，倒映在水中的明月仿佛与舟中孤独的人格外亲近！
lines.explanation: 【江清】江水清澈。【月近人】倒映水中的月亮仿佛与人相伴咫尺。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 江清月近人, mood of 宿建德江, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 江畔独步寻花
title_pinyin: jiāng pàn dú bù xún huā
appreciation: 杜甫草堂春日寻花的欢畅名作。黄四娘家花满蹊，千朵万朵压枝低。留连戏蝶时时舞，自在娇莺恰恰啼。充满对生活与春光的热爱。

lines.pinyin: huáng sì niáng jiā huā mǎn qī
lines.translation: 黄四娘家周围的花儿开得茂密繁盛，把整个院外的小路都挤满了，
lines.explanation: 【黄四娘】杜甫在草堂附近的邻居妇人。【蹊】小路、花径。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 黄四娘家花满蹊, mood of 江畔独步寻花, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: qiān duǒ wàn duǒ yā zhī dī
lines.translation: 千朵万朵怒放的花儿繁密沉甸，将柔软的枝条都压得低垂下来。
lines.explanation: 【千朵万朵】极言花朵之多。【压枝低】花重压低枝头。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 千朵万朵压枝低, mood of 江畔独步寻花, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: liú lián xì dié shí shí wǔ
lines.translation: 恋恋不舍的彩蝶在花间欢畅嬉戏，时时翩翩起舞，
lines.explanation: 【留连】依依不舍。【戏蝶】嬉戏的蝴蝶。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 留连戏蝶时时舞, mood of 江畔独步寻花, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: zì zài jiāo yīng qià qià tí
lines.translation: 自由自在娇小玲珑的黄莺，正发出恰到好处、清脆宛转的欢鸣！
lines.explanation: 【娇莺】可爱可人的黄莺鸟。【恰恰啼】鸣叫声音和谐适意。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 自在娇莺恰恰啼, mood of 江畔独步寻花, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 静夜思
appreciation: 千百年来全球华人最耳熟能详的绝唱。不假雕饰，直抒胸臆，借客舍床前的清冷月色，唤起最深切普遍的故乡之思，言简意赅，韵味悠长。

lines.translation: 皎洁明亮的月光静静洒落在床榻前地面上，
lines.explanation: 【床前】床榻或井栏前。【明月光】皎洁的月光。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 床前明月光, mood of 静夜思, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 清冷银白的光芒，恍惚间让人怀疑是初冬洒满地面的严霜。
lines.explanation: 【疑是】好像是、怀疑是。【地上霜】清冷秋霜。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 疑是地上霜, mood of 静夜思, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 忍不住抬起头来，凝望着夜空中那轮高悬的明月，
lines.explanation: 【举头】抬头。【望】远望凝视。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 举头望明月, mood of 静夜思, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 默默低下头来，对远方故乡与亲人的深切思念涌上心头！
lines.explanation: 【思】思念牵挂。【故乡】家乡。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 低头思故乡, mood of 静夜思, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵
title_pinyin: huáng hè lóu sòng mèng hào rán zhī guǎng líng
appreciation: 李白送别好友孟浩然的名作。故人西辞、烟花三月、孤帆远影、唯见长江。全诗将深厚纯真的友情融入繁华春景与滚滚江流之中，意境浩瀚，神采飞扬。

lines.pinyin: gù rén xī cí huáng hè lóu
lines.translation: 老朋友孟浩然在西面的黄鹤楼向我挥手告别，
lines.explanation: 【故人】老友，指孟浩然。【西辞】在西边的黄鹤楼告别东行。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 故人西辞黄鹤楼, mood of 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: yān huā sān yuè xià yáng zhōu
lines.translation: 在这春光明媚、如烟似霞的三月阳春，顺江东下前往繁华的扬州。
lines.explanation: 【烟花三月】繁花似锦、柳絮如烟的三月阳春。【下扬州】顺江而下去扬州（广陵）。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 烟花三月下扬州, mood of 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: gū fān yuǎn yǐng bì kōng jǐn
lines.translation: 那载着好友的一叶孤舟影子越走越远，终于消失在蔚蓝晴空的尽头，
lines.explanation: 【孤帆】孤舟船帆。【碧空尽】在碧蓝水天交界处隐没消失。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 孤帆远影碧空尽, mood of 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: wéi jiàn zhǎng jiāng tiān jì liú
lines.translation: 眼前只见浩浩荡荡的长江水，奔流不息地涌向浩渺无际的天边！
lines.explanation: 【唯见】只见。【天际流】流向天边，借滔滔江水寄托无限依依惜别之情。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 唯见长江天际流, mood of 黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 赠汪伦
appreciation: 李白游安徽泾县桃花潭时所作。李白乘舟将行，汪伦踏歌送别，桃花潭水深千尺，不及汪伦送我情。比喻纯粹真切，自然率真，友情万古流芳。

lines.pinyin: lǐ bái chéng zhōu jiāng yù xíng
lines.translation: 我李白正坐上小船准备起锚远行，
lines.explanation: 【乘舟】坐船。【将欲行】正要出发前行。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 李白乘舟将欲行, mood of 赠汪伦, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: hū wén àn shàng tà gē shēng
lines.translation: 忽然听见岸上传来伴着节拍踏地而歌的欢快歌声。
lines.explanation: 【忽闻】忽然听见。【踏歌】民间一边唱歌一边用脚踏地打拍子。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 忽闻岸上踏歌声, mood of 赠汪伦, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: táo huā tán shuǐ shēn qiān chǐ
lines.translation: 纵然那桃花潭的潭水有上千尺那样深邃幽远，
lines.explanation: 【桃花潭】在今安徽泾县西南。【深千尺】极言潭水极深。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 桃花潭水深千尺, mood of 赠汪伦, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: bù jí wāng lún sòng wǒ qíng
lines.translation: 也远远比不上老朋友汪伦前来为我送行的深情厚谊！
lines.explanation: 【不及】比不上。【送我情】汪伦送别的情谊。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 不及汪伦送我情, mood of 赠汪伦, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 九月九日忆山东兄弟
title_pinyin: jiǔ yuè jiǔ rì yì shān dōng xiōng dì
appreciation: 少年王维十七岁漫游长安时所作。独在异乡为异客，每逢佳节倍思亲。遥知兄弟登高处，遍插茱萸少一人。全诗直抒胸臆，成为千古佳节思亲代名词。

lines.pinyin: dú zài yì xiāng wèi yì kè
lines.translation: 我独自一人漂泊远离家乡，在这陌生的异地做客，
lines.explanation: 【独】独自一人。【异乡】他乡。【异客】寄居在外的客人。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 独在异乡为异客, mood of 九月九日忆山东兄弟, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: měi féng jiā jié bèi sī qīn
lines.translation: 每当遇到欢聚团圆的良辰佳节，内心便成倍地思念远方的亲人。
lines.explanation: 【佳节】美好的节日（如重阳）。【倍】加倍、更加。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 每逢佳节倍思亲, mood of 九月九日忆山东兄弟, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: yáo zhī xiōng dì dēng gāo chù
lines.translation: 远远想到远方的家乡兄弟们，一定正按照习俗登临高山峰顶，
lines.explanation: 【遥知】远远想见。【登高】重阳节登高辟邪之风俗。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 遥知兄弟登高处, mood of 九月九日忆山东兄弟, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: biàn chā zhū yú shǎo yī rén
lines.translation: 大家都佩戴着避邪的鲜红茱萸，却发现席间唯独少了我一个人！
lines.explanation: 【茱萸】一种香气浓烈的植物，古人重阳佩戴以辟邪。【少一人】单单缺少我一个。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 遍插茱萸少一人, mood of 九月九日忆山东兄弟, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 送元二使安西
title_pinyin: sòng yuán èr shǐ ān xī
appreciation: 又名《阳关三叠》《渭城曲》。朝雨浥尘、客舍青青、劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人。真挚温润，后来被谱入古琴名曲，千古流传。

lines.pinyin: wèi chéng cháo yǔ yì qīng chén
lines.translation: 清晨渭城的一场细雨，湿润了驿道上飞扬的轻尘，
lines.explanation: 【渭城】在今陕西咸阳东北。【朝雨】早晨的雨。【浥】湿润、沾湿。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 渭城朝雨浥轻尘, mood of 送元二使安西, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: kè shě qīng qīng liǔ sè xīn
lines.translation: 客栈旅舍周围青翠欲滴，柳树的枝叶被春雨洗刷得焕然一新。
lines.explanation: 【客舍】旅馆驿舍。【柳色新】柳树抽新芽，古人折柳送别。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 客舍青青柳色新, mood of 送元二使安西, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: quàn jūn gèng jǐn yī bēi jiǔ
lines.translation: 再真诚地劝好友你饮尽这杯离别的醇厚美酒，
lines.explanation: 【劝君】劝你。【更尽】再喝光。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 劝君更尽一杯酒, mood of 送元二使安西, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: xī chū yáng guān wú gù rén
lines.translation: 因为向西一旦出了荒凉险远的阳关古隘，就再也没有亲近的老朋友了！
lines.explanation: 【阳关】古关名，在今甘肃敦煌西南。【无故人】没有老朋友，点出塞外苍茫与别情之深。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 西出阳关无故人, mood of 送元二使安西, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 回乡偶书
appreciation: 八十六岁高龄告老还乡的贺知章所作。离家半个多世纪，鬓发已白乡音未改，村童相迎却当作远方来客笑问何来。平淡质朴中饱含深沉浩叹，沧桑动人。

lines.pinyin: shào xiǎo lí jiā lǎo dà huí
lines.translation: 少年轻狂时离家远行求仕，如今年迈衰老才得以返回家乡，
lines.explanation: 【少小】年轻幼小时。【老大】年老长者。【回】回到故乡。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 少小离家老大回, mood of 回乡偶书, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: xiāng yīn wú gǎi bìn máo shuāi
lines.translation: 家乡亲切的口音虽然未曾改变，两鬓的斑白头发却早已稀疏零落。
lines.explanation: 【乡音】家乡方言口音。【鬓毛衰】两鬓头发稀疏变白，读音cuī。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 乡音无改鬓毛衰, mood of 回乡偶书, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: ér tóng xiāng jiàn bù xiāng shí
lines.translation: 村里嬉戏天真的孩童们看见我，都不认识我这个白发老人，
lines.explanation: 【不相识】不认得、不知道是谁。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 儿童相见不相识, mood of 回乡偶书, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: xiào wèn kè cóng hé chù lái
lines.translation: 他们天真地笑着迎上来打听询问：老客人，您是从什么地方来的呀？
lines.explanation: 【客】客人，老归故乡却被当作外来客人，悲喜交集。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 笑问客从何处来, mood of 回乡偶书, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 赋得古原草送别
title_pinyin: fù dé gǔ yuán cǎo sòng bié
appreciation: 白居易十六岁应考成名作。“野火烧不尽，春风吹又生”成为歌颂顽强不屈生命力的千古格言，后半首融入古道斜阳送别王孙的依依别情，格调高古。

lines.translation: 原野上青草长得茂盛而绵延不绝，
lines.explanation: 【离离】草木茂盛连绵的样子。【原】辽阔的原野。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 离离原上草, mood of 赋得古原草送别, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 每年秋冬枯萎凋零，每到春夏又重新繁荣蓬勃。
lines.explanation: 【岁】年。【枯】干枯凋零。【荣】茂盛繁衍。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 一岁一枯荣, mood of 赋得古原草送别, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 即便无情的荒野大火将地面烧成灰烬，
lines.explanation: 【野火】荒原焚烧之火。【不尽】无法将其根须彻底烧绝。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 野火烧不尽, mood of 赋得古原草送别, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 待到明媚的春风徐徐吹拂，那绿意又会破土重生！
lines.explanation: 【又生】再度蓬勃萌发，极写生命力之坚韧。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 春风吹又生, mood of 赋得古原草送别, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 野草散发的清芬芳香蔓延侵占了荒凉的古驿道，
lines.explanation: 【远芳】蔓延向远方的芳草。【侵】蔓延遮盖。【古道】古代驿道。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 远芳侵古道, mood of 赋得古原草送别, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 阳光下青翠欲滴的草色连接着残破废弃的荒凉古城。
lines.explanation: 【晴翠】晴阳照耀下的翠绿草色。【荒城】荒凉的旧城池。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 晴翠接荒城, mood of 赋得古原草送别, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 如今我在这漫漫青草地上，又要送别亲密的好友远行而去，
lines.explanation: 【王孙】古代对贵族子弟或尊贵友人的泛称。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 又送王孙去, mood of 赋得古原草送别, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 那茂盛丰盈的青草芳甸，仿佛也填满了无尽的离别深情！
lines.explanation: 【萋萋】草木茂密的样子。【满别情】芳草无尽，离情亦无尽。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 萋萋满别情, mood of 赋得古原草送别, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 枫桥夜泊
appreciation: 安史之乱后避难江南所作。月落乌啼、霜满天、江枫渔火、对愁眠，夜半钟声到客船。秋夜凄清，羁旅失眠，寒山寺悠扬空灵的钟声穿透千年，成为水乡夜景绝响。

lines.pinyin: yuè luò wū tí shuāng mǎn tiān
lines.translation: 残月渐渐沉落，乌鸦在枝头发出阵阵啼鸣，天地间弥漫着清冷冰凉的寒霜，
lines.explanation: 【乌啼】乌鸦啼叫。【霜满天】秋霜弥漫天地，形容寒意浓重。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 月落乌啼霜满天, mood of 枫桥夜泊, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: jiāng fēng yú huǒ duì chóu mián
lines.translation: 面对着江边的红枫树与江面上渔舟闪烁的点点灯火，舟中人满怀羁旅愁思难以入眠。
lines.explanation: 【江枫】江边的枫树。【渔火】渔船上的灯火。【对愁眠】伴着满腹愁绪难以入睡。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 江枫渔火对愁眠, mood of 枫桥夜泊, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: gū sū chéng wài hán shān sì
lines.translation: 在姑苏城外那座古老幽静的寒山寺院里，
lines.explanation: 【姑苏】苏州古称。【寒山寺】苏州阊门外的千年古刹。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 姑苏城外寒山寺, mood of 枫桥夜泊, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: yè bàn zhōng shēng dào kè chuán
lines.translation: 半夜里敲响的那悠扬深沉的青铜钟声，飘荡着传到了我这叶孤舟客船上来！
lines.explanation: 【夜半钟声】半夜古寺敲响的幽深钟鸣。【客船】旅人乘坐的客舟。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 夜半钟声到客船, mood of 枫桥夜泊, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 别董大
appreciation: 高适与著名琴师董庭兰临别之作。千里黄云白日曛，北风吹雁雪纷纷。莫愁前路无知己，天下谁人不识君！慷慨激昂，扫尽送别诗的儿女情长，豪迈博大。

lines.pinyin: qiān lǐ huáng yún bái rì xūn
lines.translation: 千里苍穹遮蔽着昏黄的阴云，红日在大风沙尘中显得一片昏暗，
lines.explanation: 【黄云】荒漠风沙卷起的黄色沙云。【曛】昏暗日落之色。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 千里黄云白日曛, mood of 别董大, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: běi fēng chuī yàn xuě fēn fēn
lines.translation: 凛冽刺骨的北风呼啸吹卷，南飞的大雁排空而过，漫天大雪纷纷扬扬。
lines.explanation: 【吹雁】吹卷飞雁。【雪纷纷】大雪飘落之貌。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 北风吹雁雪纷纷, mood of 别董大, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: mò chóu qián lù wú zhī jǐ
lines.translation: 不要忧虑未来的漫漫前路上没有理解自己的知心好友，
lines.explanation: 【莫愁】不要担忧发愁。【知己】知心知音的好友。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 莫愁前路无知己, mood of 别董大, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: tiān xià shuí rén bù shí jūn
lines.translation: 普天之下举目四海，有哪一个人不敬仰认识先生您的高超才华呢！
lines.explanation: 【识君】赏识知晓你。豪迈豁达，给予友人莫大鼓舞。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 天下谁人不识君, mood of 别董大, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 芙蓉楼送辛渐
title_pinyin: fú róng lóu sòng xīn jiàn
appreciation: 寒雨连江夜入吴，平明送客楚山孤。洛阳亲友如相问，一片冰心在玉壶。王昌龄借清澈无瑕的冰心玉壶，表达自己清正廉洁、坚贞不屈的高洁情操。

lines.pinyin: hán yǔ lián jiāng yè rù wú
lines.translation: 迷蒙清冷的夜雨连绵笼罩长江，在漫漫长夜里悄悄注入这吴地江山，
lines.explanation: 【寒雨】清冷秋雨。【连江】烟雨笼罩江天。【吴】江南吴地镇江一带。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 寒雨连江夜入吴, mood of 芙蓉楼送辛渐, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: píng míng sòng kè chǔ shān gū
lines.translation: 清晨破晓时分在江楼送别挚友，举目望去楚地群山显得格外孤单寂寥。
lines.explanation: 【平明】天亮拂晓。【楚山孤】以楚山的孤独映衬离别的寂寞孤清。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 平明送客楚山孤, mood of 芙蓉楼送辛渐, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: luò yáng qīn yǒu rú xiāng wèn
lines.translation: 到了洛阳之后，如果那里的亲朋好友问起我的近况，
lines.explanation: 【相问】打听问候。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 洛阳亲友如相问, mood of 芙蓉楼送辛渐, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: yī piàn bīng xīn zài yù hú
lines.translation: 请告诉他们：我依然如从前一样，一片纯洁坚贞的冰心，安放在晶莹剔透的玉壶之中！
lines.explanation: 【冰心】晶莹纯洁如冰的心。【玉壶】纯净玉质的容器，比喻品格冰清玉洁。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 一片冰心在玉壶, mood of 芙蓉楼送辛渐, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 夜雨寄北
appreciation: 君问归期未有期，巴山夜雨涨秋池。何当共剪西窗烛，却话巴山夜雨时。时空交错，虚实相生，把巴山夜雨的孤寂与未来相聚的温情写得百转千回，深情动人。

lines.pinyin: jūn wèn guī qī wèi yǒu qī
lines.translation: 你来信询问我何时能够归来，可我归家的日期如今仍无法确定，
lines.explanation: 【君】妻子或好友。【归期】回家的日期。【未有期】没有确定之时。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 君问归期未有期, mood of 夜雨寄北, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: bā shān yè yǔ zhǎng qiū chí
lines.translation: 此刻巴山漫漫长夜里秋雨连绵倾盆，早已涨满了院中的池塘。
lines.explanation: 【巴山】大巴山一带。【涨秋池】秋雨磅礴使得池水涨满溢出。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 巴山夜雨涨秋池, mood of 夜雨寄北, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: hé dāng gòng jiǎn xī chuāng zhú
lines.translation: 究竟何时我们才能重聚在西窗之下，一起亲手修剪那明亮的蜡烛芯，
lines.explanation: 【何当】什么时候能够。【共剪西窗烛】夫妻知己促膝长谈之温情。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 何当共剪西窗烛, mood of 夜雨寄北, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: què huà bā shān yè yǔ shí
lines.translation: 到那时再回过头来，向你细细诉说今夜我在巴山深处听雨时的无尽相思！
lines.explanation: 【却话】再谈论回叙。【巴山夜雨时】回首今夜巴山孤寂之雨境。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 却话巴山夜雨时, mood of 夜雨寄北, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 相思
appreciation: 红豆生南国，春来发几枝。愿君多采撷，此物最相思。以象征相思的南国红豆起兴，语浅情深，委婉含蓄，成为千古寄托相思真情的绝美诗章。

lines.translation: 象征相思情深的红豆，生长在温润明媚的南方土地上，
lines.explanation: 【红豆】相思子，南国红豆果实鲜红光润，古来象征纯真爱恋相思。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 红豆生南国, mood of 相思, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 当春天到来的时候，它又悄然萌发出了多少嫩绿的枝条呢？
lines.explanation: 【发几枝】生长抽出几根新枝，寄托生机与情意。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 春来发几枝, mood of 相思, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 希望你远在南方的朋友能够多多采摘那些娇艳的红豆，
lines.explanation: 【采撷】采摘、摘取。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 愿君多采撷, mood of 相思, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 因为这种小巧鲜红的植物，最能寄托人世间最深切真挚的相思！
lines.explanation: 【相思】牵挂思念，情深意重。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 此物最相思, mood of 相思, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 鹿柴
appreciation: 空山不见人，但闻人语响。返景入深林，复照青苔上。以动衬静，以声衬幽，在幽深空寂的山林之中，一抹夕阳返照在青苔之上，充满了禅境的空灵澄澈。

lines.translation: 空旷幽深的山林之中看不见半个人影，
lines.explanation: 【空山】空旷寂静的深山。【鹿柴】读音lù zhài，王维辋川别业胜景之一。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 空山不见人, mood of 鹿柴, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 只是偶尔隐隐约约听见不知何处传来的人们说笑的话音。
lines.explanation: 【但闻】只听见。【人语响】隐约人声回响，更显山谷空旷幽寂。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 但闻人语响, mood of 鹿柴, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 夕阳返照的一抹绚丽光芒穿透繁茂的枝叶，洒入幽暗深邃的树林深处，
lines.explanation: 【返景】夕阳回照之光，景同“影”。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 返景入深林, mood of 鹿柴, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 又静静照耀在岩石斑驳碧绿的潮湿青苔之上。
lines.explanation: 【复照】再次照亮。【青苔】阴湿地生长的苔藓，幽光与青苔相互映衬。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 复照青苔上, mood of 鹿柴, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 竹里馆
appreciation: 独坐幽篁里，弹琴复长啸。深林人不知，明月来相照。王维隐居辋川的自适之作。高雅绝俗，以琴声、长啸、修竹、明月构筑起超脱尘世的宁静心境。

lines.translation: 我独自一人静静坐在幽深茂密的翠竹林间，
lines.explanation: 【幽篁】幽深茂密的竹林。【独坐】安详静坐。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 独坐幽篁里, mood of 竹里馆, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 一边轻抚古琴弹奏高雅的曲调，一边昂首发出悠长畅快的长啸。
lines.explanation: 【弹琴】弹奏七弦古琴。【长啸】高歌、长舒胸中清气。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 弹琴复长啸, mood of 竹里馆, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 这深邃竹林清幽隐秘，世俗之人都不知道我在这儿，
lines.explanation: 【深林】深邃林壑。【人不知】尘世无人知晓打扰。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 深林人不知, mood of 竹里馆, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 唯有夜空中那轮晶莹清澈的明月，穿透竹梢静静前来相伴映照！
lines.explanation: 【来相照】照拂相伴，把明月当得知己知音。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 明月来相照, mood of 竹里馆, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 山居秋暝
appreciation: 空山新雨后，天气晚来秋。明月松间照，清泉石上流。竹喧归浣女，莲动下渔舟。随意春芳歇，王孙自可留。王维山水田园诗集大成之作，诗中有画，画中有诗。

lines.translation: 空旷寂静的群山刚刚沐浴过一场清新的初秋细雨，
lines.explanation: 【新雨】初下的雨水。【空山】空明寂静的山野。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 空山新雨后, mood of 山居秋暝, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 傍晚时分山风徐徐吹来，天气透出阵阵舒爽宜人的秋意。
lines.explanation: 【晚来秋】傍晚带来了浓浓的秋天凉爽气息。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 天气晚来秋, mood of 山居秋暝, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 皎洁清幽的明月穿过苍翠松针枝柯，将银辉洒满林间，
lines.explanation: 【明月】皎洁秋月。【松间照】透过苍松林隙洒下银光。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 明月松间照, mood of 山居秋暝, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 澄澈碧透的泉水在青苔卵石上潺潺流淌，发出清脆悦耳的叮咚声。
lines.explanation: 【清泉】清澈泉水。【石上流】在山石间欢畅流淌。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 清泉石上流, mood of 山居秋暝, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 翠竹林中传来阵阵欢声笑语，那是洗完衣裳的洗衣姑娘们结伴归家，
lines.explanation: 【竹喧】竹林里的笑语喧哗。【浣女】洗衣服的纯朴女子。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 竹喧归浣女, mood of 山居秋暝, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 水面荷叶摇摆莲花晃动，原来是顺流而下的打渔小舟正穿过荷塘。
lines.explanation: 【莲动】荷叶荷花摇曳。【下渔舟】顺流而下的小渔船。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 莲动下渔舟, mood of 山居秋暝, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 任凭春天的芳菲花草随着季节变换自然凋零褪去，
lines.explanation: 【随意】任凭。【春芳歇】春天的花草凋零消歇。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 随意春芳歇, mood of 山居秋暝, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 秋日山居这般安闲高洁，归隐的雅士自当长久留连居停！
lines.explanation: 【王孙】这里代指诗人自己。【留】留居山林归隐。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 王孙自可留, mood of 山居秋暝, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 寻隐者不遇
appreciation: 松下问童子，言师采药去。只在此山中，云深不知处。全诗纯用问答对话结构，言简意赅，把寻隐者的期望、失望与对深山高人的仰慕表达得如入画中。

lines.translation: 在一棵苍劲的青松树下，我向隐者的小弟子打听询问，
lines.explanation: 【松下】苍松之下。【童子】道童或弟子。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 松下问童子, mood of 寻隐者不遇, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 童子恭敬地回答说：我的师父清晨上山采集草药去了。
lines.explanation: 【言】回答说。【采药去】进山采集灵草草药。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 言师采药去, mood of 寻隐者不遇, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 师父就在这重重苍茫的巍峨大山深处，
lines.explanation: 【只在此山】就在眼前这座青山之中。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 只在此山中, mood of 寻隐者不遇, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 可是山高林密云雾极其弥漫，根本不知道他究竟在何处！
lines.explanation: 【云深】山中云雾极其深厚缭绕。【不知处】不知具体居所。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 云深不知处, mood of 寻隐者不遇, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 登乐游原
appreciation: 向晚意不适，驱车登古原。夕阳无限好，只是近黄昏。晚唐诗人的千古慨叹。盛唐气象已逝，面对灿烂凄迷的夕阳黄昏，既赞美其壮丽，又深怀惋惜之情。

lines.translation: 临近傍晚黄昏时分心情有些郁闷烦躁与不快，
lines.explanation: 【向晚】傍晚天色将暮之时。【意不适】心情不舒畅郁闷。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 向晚意不适, mood of 登乐游原, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 于是赶着马车，登上了地势开阔的乐游古原散心，
lines.explanation: 【驱车】赶着马车。【古原】乐游原，长安城东南地势高敞之名胜。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 驱车登古原, mood of 登乐游原, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 只见那一轮红彤彤的落日与漫天晚霞，景象是那样绚烂壮美、无比令人沉醉，
lines.explanation: 【无限好】无比美好、极具壮阔之美。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 夕阳无限好, mood of 登乐游原, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 只可惜天色已经逼近黑夜黄昏，这美好的景象很快就要消失在暮色之中！
lines.explanation: 【只是】只是、可惜。【近黄昏】逼近黑夜，蕴含对美好事物转瞬即逝的浩叹。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 只是近黄昏, mood of 登乐游原, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 秋夕
appreciation: 银烛秋光冷画屏，轻罗小扇扑流萤。天阶夜色凉如水，卧看牵牛织女星。描绘了一幅幽冷深沉的宫廷秋夜图，细腻刻画了失意宫女望月观星的孤寂心境。

lines.pinyin: yín zhú qiū guāng lěng huà píng
lines.translation: 银白色的蜡烛散发着清冷秋光，映照在画有山水图画的屏风上显得格外冷寂，
lines.explanation: 【银烛】银白色的蜡烛。【冷画屏】秋夜烛光微弱，屏风显得凄冷。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 银烛秋光冷画屏, mood of 秋夕, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: qīng luó xiǎo shàn pū liú yíng
lines.translation: 少女手握着轻薄的丝罗小扇，轻轻扑打着在夜色中飞舞的荧荧萤火虫。
lines.explanation: 【轻罗小扇】丝绸制作的精致团扇。【扑流萤】扑打飞舞的萤火虫。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 轻罗小扇扑流萤, mood of 秋夕, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: tiān jiē yè sè liáng rú shuǐ
lines.translation: 露天石阶之上的茫茫夜色，如同寒凉的秋水一般冰冷刺骨，
lines.explanation: 【天阶】露天的石阶宫阶。【凉如水】夜色寒凉如水。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 天阶夜色凉如水, mood of 秋夕, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: wò kàn qiān niú zhī nǚ xīng
lines.translation: 只能久久斜卧凝望着银河两岸那隔水遥遥相望的牵牛星与织女星。
lines.explanation: 【卧看】斜卧凝望。【牵牛织女星】牛郎星与织女星，神话中隔银河相望之星宿。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 卧看牵牛织女星, mood of 秋夕, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 问刘十九
appreciation: 绿蚁新醅酒，红泥小火炉。晚来天欲雪，能饮一杯无？通篇如叙家常，色彩温馨（新绿酒、红泥炉、漫天白雪），流淌着冬日寒夜中围炉对饮的浓浓温情与知己之乐。

lines.translation: 刚刚酿就的米酒上面漂浮着如绿色细蚁般的浮沫，醇香扑鼻，
lines.explanation: 【绿蚁】新酿米酒未过滤前浮在酒面上的细小绿色酒沫。【醅】没有过滤的米酒。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 绿蚁新醅酒, mood of 问刘十九, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 简朴质朴的红泥小火炉里，炭火正烧得通红温暖，
lines.explanation: 【红泥小火炉】红陶泥烧制的小取暖烧酒火炉。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 红泥小火炉, mood of 问刘十九, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 天色将晚，阴沉沉的天空正酝酿着一场漫天大雪，
lines.explanation: 【晚来】入夜傍晚。【天欲雪】天气阴冷即将降大雪。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 晚来天欲雪, mood of 问刘十九, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 朋友啊，在这寒风呼啸的雪夜，你愿意过来跟我围炉喝上一杯暖酒吗？
lines.explanation: 【无】么、不，表示亲切关切的征询问语。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 能饮一杯无, mood of 问刘十九, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 古朗月行·节选
title_pinyin: gǔ lǎng yuè xíng jié xuǎn
appreciation: 李白回忆童年望月的情景。小时不识月，呼作白玉盘。又疑瑶台镜，飞在青云端。充满儿童天真纯净的想象力与李白式浪漫奔放的奇思妙想。

lines.translation: 小的时候还不知道天空中挂着的是月亮，
lines.explanation: 【小时】年幼童年时。【不识月】不晓得月亮的名称与来历。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 小时不识月, mood of 古朗月行·节选, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 天真地指着它欢呼叫喊，以为那是一只晶莹剔透的白玉圆盘。
lines.explanation: 【呼作】称呼它作为。【白玉盘】羊脂白玉做成的精美圆盘。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 呼作白玉盘, mood of 古朗月行·节选, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 有时候又怀疑那是神仙居住的瑶台仙宫里的宝镜，
lines.explanation: 【瑶台】传说中西王母所居的神仙宫阙。【瑶台镜】仙人使用的宝镜。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 又疑瑶台镜, mood of 古朗月行·节选, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 神奇地飞升悬挂在湛蓝纯净的青天白云最高端！
lines.explanation: 【青云端】蔚蓝苍穹云海的顶端。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 飞在青云端, mood of 古朗月行·节选, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 凉州词·黄河远上
title_pinyin: liáng zhōu cí huáng hé yuǎn shàng
appreciation: 黄河远上白云间，一片孤城万仞山。羌笛何须怨杨柳，春风不度玉门关。被誉为唐代绝句的压卷之作。辽阔苍凉的边塞风光与慷慨悲壮的家国情怀融为一体，气势撼人。

lines.pinyin: huáng hé yuǎn shàng bái yún jiān
lines.translation: 浩瀚奔腾的黄河蜿蜒曲折，远远望去仿佛奔涌流入高耸万丈的白云之间，
lines.explanation: 【黄河远上】极目远望黄河连天。【白云间】极言河源地势极高。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 黄河远上白云间, mood of 凉州词·黄河远上, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: yī piàn gū chéng wàn rèn shān
lines.translation: 重重叠叠耸立如削的万仞高山环抱之中，耸立着一座孤零零的边塞城堡。
lines.explanation: 【孤城】边疆孤立的军塞戍城。【万仞山】千峰耸立的高山，仞为古长度单位。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 一片孤城万仞山, mood of 凉州词·黄河远上, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: qiāng dí hé xū yuàn yáng liǔ
lines.translation: 哀怨凄婉的羌笛声何必去吹奏那哀伤的《折杨柳》古曲呢，
lines.explanation: 【羌笛】羌族乐器竹笛。【怨杨柳】指吹奏思乡曲目《折杨柳》。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 羌笛何须怨杨柳, mood of 凉州词·黄河远上, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: chūn fēng bù dù yù mén guān
lines.translation: 温暖宜人的阳春和风，本来就吹不到这苍凉偏远的玉门雄关啊！
lines.explanation: 【度】越过、吹过。【玉门关】古代西陲著名边关，在今甘肃敦煌西北。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 春风不度玉门关, mood of 凉州词·黄河远上, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 凉州词·葡萄美酒
title_pinyin: liáng zhōu cí pú táo měi jiǔ
appreciation: 葡萄美酒夜光杯，欲饮琵琶马上催。醉卧沙场君莫笑，古来征战几人回？痛快淋漓地表现了边塞将士置生死于度外的旷达与豪放，悲凉中见壮烈。

lines.pinyin: pú táo měi jiǔ yè guāng bēi
lines.translation: 甘甜醇厚的西域葡萄美酒，盛放在晶莹闪烁的夜光美玉杯中，
lines.explanation: 【葡萄美酒】西域特产葡萄酒。【夜光杯】用白玉精制能发微光的珍贵酒杯。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 葡萄美酒夜光杯, mood of 凉州词·葡萄美酒, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: yù yǐn pí pá mǎ shàng cuī
lines.translation: 将士们正要开怀痛饮，战马上催人出征急如骤雨的琵琶声便急促响起了！
lines.explanation: 【欲饮】正想畅饮。【马上催】骑在马上弹奏琵琶催促队伍出发。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 欲饮琵琶马上催, mood of 凉州词·葡萄美酒, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: zuì wò shā chǎng jūn mò xiào
lines.translation: 即便是我们醉倒在荒凉辽阔的黄沙战场之上，朋友们也请千万不要见笑，
lines.explanation: 【沙场】战场。【君莫笑】诸位请不要笑话嘲笑。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 醉卧沙场君莫笑, mood of 凉州词·葡萄美酒, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: gǔ lái zhēng zhàn jǐ rén huí
lines.translation: 试问从古至今奔赴这生死难测的沙场征战，又有几个人能够活着平安归来呢！
lines.explanation: 【几人回】几个人能回来，道尽边塞战争的惨烈与将士的向死而生。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 古来征战几人回, mood of 凉州词·葡萄美酒, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 出塞
appreciation: 秦时明月汉时关，万里长征人未还。但使龙城飞将在，不教胡马度阴山。借古讽今，气象雄浑，渴望良将安边定国、让天下将士共享和平安宁。

lines.pinyin: qín shí míng yuè hàn shí guān
lines.translation: 秦汉时期高悬的清冷明月，照耀着秦汉以来坚守的巍峨边关，
lines.explanation: 【秦时明月汉时关】互文见义，指自秦汉以来边疆战事延续千年，关山依旧。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 秦时明月汉时关, mood of 出塞, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: wàn lǐ cháng zhēng rén wèi hái
lines.translation: 千千万万奔赴万里边塞远征的戍边将士，至今仍未能够返回故土家园。
lines.explanation: 【万里长征】远隔千里的边疆守卫。【人未还】许多人血洒疆场未能生还。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 万里长征人未还, mood of 出塞, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: dàn shǐ lóng chéng fēi jiāng zài
lines.translation: 倘若今天能有西汉飞将军李广那般英勇善战的名将在镇守边陲，
lines.explanation: 【但使】只要。【龙城飞将】指威震匈奴的汉代飞将军李广与名将卫青。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 但使龙城飞将在, mood of 出塞, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: bù jiào hú mǎ dù yīn shān
lines.translation: 就绝不会允许凶残的外敌铁骑踏破重山，越过北方的阴山半步！
lines.explanation: 【不教】决不允许。【胡马】古代北方游牧军队。【阴山】北疆著名山脉防御要塞。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 不教胡马度阴山, mood of 出塞, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 登幽州台歌
appreciation: 前不见古人，后不见来者。念天地之悠悠，独怆然而涕下。将个人怀才不遇的孤独放置于无限辽阔的宇宙时空坐标之中，苍凉悲壮，慷慨激昂，震古烁今。

lines.translation: 往前极目回首，再也看不见古代那些礼贤下士的英明君王，
lines.explanation: 【古人】古代礼贤下士的明君贤臣，如燕昭王。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 前不见古人, mood of 登幽州台歌, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.translation: 往后极目远眺，也见不到未来有哪位知音能够理解我的抱负，
lines.explanation: 【来者】未来的贤能明主与知音。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 后不见来者, mood of 登幽州台歌, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: niàn tiān dì zhī yōu yōu
lines.translation: 想到这无边无际的茫茫宇宙和漫长无止境的岁月长河，
lines.explanation: 【念】想到。【悠悠】辽阔深远无止境貌。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 念天地之悠悠, mood of 登幽州台歌, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: dú chuàng rán ér tì xià
lines.translation: 我孤身一人登上这古台，禁不住悲伤凄凉、热泪滚滚横流！
lines.explanation: 【独】孤单一人。【怆然】悲伤凄凉貌。【涕下】眼泪夺眶而出。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 独怆然而涕下, mood of 登幽州台歌, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 黄鹤楼
appreciation: 相传李白登黄鹤楼读此诗叹曰：“眼前有景道不得，崔颢题诗在上头。”气象万千，历历晴川，萋萋芳草，日暮乡关，浑然天成，被誉为唐代七律第一。

lines.pinyin: xī rén yǐ chéng huáng hè qù
lines.translation: 传说中古代的仙人早已驾鹤西去飞向九天，
lines.explanation: 【昔人】昔日古代的仙人。【黄鹤】神话中仙人所骑乘的金黄色仙鹤。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 昔人已乘黄鹤去, mood of 黄鹤楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: cǐ dì kòng yú huáng hè lóu
lines.translation: 如今这江畔胜地只空空留下一座孤耸巍峨的黄鹤楼。
lines.explanation: 【空余】只空落落地剩下。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 此地空余黄鹤楼, mood of 黄鹤楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: huáng hè yī qù bù fù fǎn
lines.translation: 那只仙鹤一旦远去便再也没有返回这人间，
lines.explanation: 【不复返】再也没有回来。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 黄鹤一去不复返, mood of 黄鹤楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: bái yún qiān zài kōng yōu yōu
lines.translation: 唯有浩浩苍穹中的朵朵白云，千百年来依然自在悠闲地飘浮飘荡。
lines.explanation: 【千载】千年。【空悠悠】徒然悠闲飘荡，物是人非。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 白云千载空悠悠, mood of 黄鹤楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: qíng chuān lì lì hàn yáng shù
lines.translation: 阳光明媚晴好的江原上，汉阳城边的棵棵绿树清晰分明，
lines.explanation: 【晴川】晴阳映照下的江面平原。【历历】清晰分明貌。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 晴川历历汉阳树, mood of 黄鹤楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: fāng cǎo qī qī yīng wǔ zhōu
lines.translation: 江中鹦鹉洲上的茂盛芳草一片碧绿，生机盎然。
lines.explanation: 【芳草萋萋】茂盛青绿的芳草。【鹦鹉洲】汉阳江中的著名沙洲。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 芳草萋萋鹦鹉洲, mood of 黄鹤楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: rì mù xiāng guān hé chù shì
lines.translation: 暮色渐渐降临，举目四望我的故乡究竟在什么地方呢？
lines.explanation: 【日暮】黄昏日落之时。【乡关】故乡家园。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 日暮乡关何处是, mood of 黄鹤楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: yān bō jiāng shàng shǐ rén chóu
lines.translation: 只见这浩浩荡荡江面上笼罩的茫茫烟波，直让人心头涌起无尽的思乡愁绪！
lines.explanation: 【烟波】江水雾霭烟气。【使人愁】令游子羁旅伤感愁思。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 烟波江上使人愁, mood of 黄鹤楼, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 乌衣巷
appreciation: 朱雀桥边野草花，乌衣巷口夕阳斜。旧时王谢堂前燕，飞入寻常百姓家。凭吊东晋王导、谢安望族盛极而衰的历史变迁，沧桑幽远，回味深长。

lines.pinyin: zhū què qiáo biān yě cǎo huā
lines.translation: 当年繁华喧嚣的朱雀桥边，如今只有荒凉凄清的野草开着杂花，
lines.explanation: 【朱雀桥】南京秦淮河上古代繁盛要桥。【野草花】荒野杂草开花，显冷落衰败。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 朱雀桥边野草花, mood of 乌衣巷, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: wū yī xiàng kǒu xī yáng xié
lines.translation: 昔日高门显贵的乌衣巷口，只剩下一抹落寞惨淡的残阳斜斜照耀。
lines.explanation: 【乌衣巷】东晋豪门世族王导、谢安居住的巷弄。【夕阳斜】夕阳斜照，象征没落。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 乌衣巷口夕阳斜, mood of 乌衣巷, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: jiù shí wáng xiè táng qián yàn
lines.translation: 昔日经常栖息在王谢豪门显贵雕梁画栋深宅大院里的紫燕，
lines.explanation: 【王谢】东晋宰相王导与谢安家族，代指极盛世家豪门。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 旧时王谢堂前燕, mood of 乌衣巷, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

lines.pinyin: fēi rù xún cháng bǎi xìng jiā
lines.translation: 如今只能栖飞进入普通寻常平民百姓的屋檐屋舍之下！
lines.explanation: 【寻常百姓家】普通庶民的家庭，对比强烈，道尽历史沧海桑田。
lines.image_prompt: Traditional Chinese ink-and-wash painting illustrating Tang poem line: 飞入寻常百姓家, mood of 乌衣巷, oriental aesthetic, masterwork watercolor.

title: 题破山寺后禅院
title_pinyin: tí pò shān sì hòu chán yuàn
appreciation: 常建游览破山寺后禅院所作，曲径通幽处，禅房花木深，山光悦鸟性，潭影空人心，极写山寺幽深寂静之禅境。
